description.zh-CN: 由原工作簿“Deferred income”工作表转换而成的中英双语智能表单。每项可执行程序均使用结构化的“是否执行、执行结果、底稿引用和备注”记录。
description.en-US: Bilingual SmartForm converted from the Deferred income worksheet. Each executable procedure uses a structured Test required, Result, Working paper references and Comments record.

title.zh-CN: 递延收入——一般审计程序

description.zh-CN: 审计目标：1）确保递延收入已正确核算且记录完整；2）确认递延收入所需披露均已作出，且相关信息已得到适当列报和说明。
description.en-US: Audit objectives: (1) Ensure that deferred income has been correctly accounted for and is complete. (2) Confirm that all necessary disclosures concerning deferred income have been made and that the information is appropriately presented and described.

prompt.zh-CN: 取得并检查（或编制）本年度的主表，并将其与总账核对。
prompt.en-US: Obtain and check, or prepare, a lead schedule for the current year’s figures and reconcile this to the general ledger.

prompt.zh-CN: 执行分析程序，将本期数据与以前期间的数据进行比较；
prompt.en-US: Carry out analytical procedures by comparing the current figures with those of prior periods.

prompt.zh-CN: 执行分析程序，复核并比较关键比率或其他绩效指标。
prompt.en-US: Carry out analytical procedures by reviewing and comparing key ratios or other performance indicators.

prompt.zh-CN: 复核超过执行重要性水平或其他异常的项目，并进行验证。
prompt.en-US: Review for items above performance materiality or that are otherwise unusual and verify.

prompt.zh-CN: 复核递延收入的确认基础并核对支持性文件；
prompt.en-US: Review the basis for deferring income and vouch to supporting documents; and

prompt.zh-CN: 复核递延收入的确认基础，确保该基础有效、完整，并已按照与上年度一致的方法及适用会计准则正确应用。
prompt.en-US: Review the basis for deferring income and ensure that it is valid and complete and has been correctly and consistently applied with the prior year and applicable accounting standards.

prompt.zh-CN: 确保被审计单位按照适用的会计准则核算外币交易。
prompt.en-US: Ensure the entity accounted for foreign currency transactions in accordance with applicable accounting standards.

prompt.zh-CN: 确认所有货币性负债均已按适当的期末汇率折算。
prompt.en-US: Confirm that all monetary liabilities have been translated at an appropriate closing rate.

description.zh-CN: 评估递延收入相关列报和披露是否有充分、适当的审计证据支持。
description.en-US: Evaluate whether the presentation and disclosures relating to deferred income are supported by sufficient appropriate audit evidence.

prompt.zh-CN: 确保审计档案中有充分、适当的证据支持所有已作出的披露。
prompt.en-US: Ensure that there is sufficient appropriate evidence on the file to support all disclosures made.

description.zh-CN: 记录并执行因本项目具体情况而需要的额外审计程序。
description.en-US: Document and perform additional audit procedures required by the specific circumstances of the engagement.

prompt.zh-CN: 如有需要，设计并执行必要的额外测试，并与相关工作底稿中的审计目标相互索引。
prompt.en-US: Draft and perform any necessary additional tests if required and cross reference with the objectives on the relevant working paper.

description.zh-CN: 完成递延收入审计程序的收尾评估。
description.en-US: Complete the closing assessment for the deferred income audit programme.

prompt.zh-CN: 考虑是否存在需要纳入管理层声明书或向治理层报告的事项，并作适当记录。
prompt.en-US: Consider whether there are any points which need to be included in a letter of representation or report to those charged with governance and record as appropriate.

prompt.zh-CN: 复核本领域对内部控制的计划依赖程度，并考虑该依赖程度是否仍然适当。
prompt.en-US: Review the planned extent of reliance on internal controls in this area and consider whether this remains appropriate.

prompt.zh-CN: 根据已取得的审计证据，评估是否应修订初始重要性水平和／或风险评估。记录任何必要调整的详情，并考虑其对剩余审计工作及截至目前已执行工作的影响。
prompt.en-US: Assess whether the initial materiality and/or risk assessment should be revised in view of the audit evidence obtained. Record details of any necessary adjustments. Consider the impact on the remainder of the audit work and on any work undertaken to date.

description.zh-CN: 请依据已执行的审计工作完成最终结论；如存在例外事项，请在后续文本框中说明。
description.en-US: Complete the final conclusion based on the audit work performed. Describe any exceptions in the following text field.

helpText.zh-CN: 根据已执行的审计工作，我确认：已按照审计程序执行工作；已充分记录所执行的工作及取得的结果；已收集财务报表列报与披露所需的全部资料；已取得充分、适当的证据支持所达成的审计结论；并且在我看来，递延收入已得到公允列报（如未公允列报，请在下方说明）。
helpText.en-US: From the audit work carried out, I confirm that: the work has been performed in accordance with the audit programme; the work performed and results obtained have been adequately documented; all necessary information has been collected for presentation and disclosure in the financial statements; sufficient appropriate evidence has been obtained to support the audit conclusion reached; and, in my opinion, deferred income is fairly stated (if not, describe below).

prompt.zh-CN: 例外事项或补充说明（可选）
